mapper.select: /*selectSellerMpDsOrderObtnodrReceiptPopList*/ SELECT A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT DESCRIPTION_LOC FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER=A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO=A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS DESCRIPTION, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=A.PURCHASER_ID) AS PURCHASER_NAME, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, A.DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT, A.REF_NO AS REF_NO, A.REMARK, A.AGENT AS AGENT, A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, A.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, A.ADD_TIME AS ADD_TIME, B.DS_QTY AS DS_QTY, B.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE, B.BTOA_REMARK AS BTOA_REMARK, B.ATOS_REMARK AS ATOS_REMARK FROM DB_OFF_PO A, DB_OFF_IV B WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer} AND A.ADD_DATE=#{st_add_date} AND A.SEQ=#{st_seq} AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND A.ADD_DATE=B.ADD_DATE AND A.SEQ=B.SEQ AND B.DS_SEQ=#{st_ds_seq}
